song.author: Hillsong Worship, Darlene Zschech
song.title: One Day
song.lyrics:
[V1] More than I could hope or dream of You have poured your favour on me One day in the house of God is Better than a thousand days in the world
[C1] So blessed, I can't contain it So much, I've got to give it away Your love taught me to live now You are, more than enough for me
[B1] Lord, You're more than enough for me Lord, You're more than enough for me Lord, You're more than enough for me Lord, You're more than enough for me
